testing_mandate.rule: Every interactive and critical information component MUST include a role-based data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the complete CasaLavoriPRO application with React, Framer Motion, Lenis, Lucide icons, and Tailwind CSS.
Ensure Italian language throughout the entire user interface and sample seed data.
Maintain high contrast dark blue (#0B132B) and energetic terracotta orange (#FF5A1F) color scheme.
Ensure the hero section search directly filters the company directory or opens search results seamlessly.
Provide interactive quote request flow for privati and interactive quote submission flow for aziende.
Include mock or real endpoints connected to FastAPI and MongoDB backend for authentication, company search, and quote requests.
Add testid attributes strictly as specified in data-testid rules to satisfy automated validation.
Make sure smooth scrolling with Lenis and Framer motion section transitions are active.
